text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The day arrived for Kaori to board the ship and set off.
text_block_list.orig_text: カオリが船に乗り、出発する日がやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ah... {0}.
Did you come to see me off?
I'm just heading over to the docks myself~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
{0}。
見送りに来てくれたの～？
私もこれから
船着き場の方に行くとこさー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The folks from Caon were really livening things up for me just a little while ago!
We all sang, danced, and had a blast together~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきまで
【自警団（カォン）】のみんなに、
でーじ盛大に盛り上げてもらってたんだよ～♪
みんなで歌って踊って、
大騒ぎしたさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...The day of departure has finally arrived~
It still hasn't really sunk in yet~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いよいよ出発の日なんだね～
まだ、
実感がわかないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That said... It might take some time, but I'm definitely coming back to this town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
時間はかかるかもしれないけど、
絶対にまたこの街に
戻ってくるからね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Until then, I guess this is where we say goodbye~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それまで、
少しの
お別れさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing~sa! More importantly, I should contact the captain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
なんでもないさー！
それより、
早く船長さんのところに──

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: Damn it, what the hell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ、
なんてこった！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Huh? Captain? What's with all the commotion?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？　
船長さん？
なんだか騒がしいけど
どうしたの～？

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, young lady.
Sorry, I know we were supposed to leave today... yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
お嬢ちゃんか。
……すまねぇな、
出発は今日の予定だったんだが……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: A monster~sa... in the sea?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海に……
魔物さ～！？

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
That bastard is completely blocking the shipping lane!
He's already sunk the ships nearby...
If things keep going like this, my ship is next...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの野郎が
思いっきり航路を塞ぎやがってるんだ！
近くにあった船も沈めやがって、
このままじゃ
俺の船も……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's terrible~sa! We have to do something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは大変さー！
なんとかしないと～！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
I'd love nothing more than to jump into action, of course...
But that bastard won't come anywhere near the shore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんそうしたいのは山々なんだが、
あの野郎、
陸の方には近寄ってきやがらねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There's no way to reach it from here...
I've got to get closer...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここからじゃ、
手の出しようがないねー
こっちから
近づかなきゃ～……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's trying to attack the ship! No!
text_block_list.orig_text:
船を攻撃しようとしてるさー！？
ダメだよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: Hey, young man, don't be so reckless!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい兄ちゃん、
無謀なこと言ってんじゃねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I hate to admit it, but he's right!
With a commotion this big, everyone from Caon is sure to come running right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
悔しいけど、
そうだよ～！
これだけの騒ぎになれば、
きっと
【自警団（カォン）】のみんなが
すぐ来てくれるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Eh? You think they might not make it in time...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
それじゃ間に合わないかも……
って？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You're worried about me...?
It's fine~!
You don't have to try so hard for me~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私のため……？
そんなの、
いいんだよ～！
私のために
そんなに頑張ろうとしなくても～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Why... would you go that far...?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしてそこまで……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Eek! Y-You... You can't just say things like that out of the blue! You can't~sa!
I'm happy, sure, but it makes my heart race!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ！？
い、
いきなり
そういうこと言うのはいけないさ～！
うれしいけど、
ドキドキしちゃうよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
{0}, you really pay close attention to me, don't you?
Thinking about it makes me feel a little embarrassed...~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は、
私のことをよく見てるんだねー……
そう考えると、
ちょっと
恥ずかしくなってくるよ～……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I see... you were doing all sorts of things because I was feeling down~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～……
{0}は、
私が元気なかったから、
色々としてくれてたんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: For my sake... To see me lively and happy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私のために……
元気な私を見るために……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it~sa...
No more hemming and hawing, I'm done hesitating!
I'm going to fight right alongside you! If we join forces, we'll knock out that monster out in a single blow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
分かったさー……
ウジウジ迷うなんて、
面倒はやめる！
私も一緒に戦うよ～！
私たちが力を合わせれば、
あんな魔物
一発でノックアウトさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Captain, sorry to ask, but could you take the ship out?
I want to get closer to that monster~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
船長さん、
悪いんだけど、
船を出してもらえるかな～？
あの魔物に近づきたいんさ～！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: Not only him, have you also gone insane, young lady!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
兄ちゃんもお嬢ちゃんも、
正気か！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You bet!
I'm confident in my strength, after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんさー！
腕っぷしには自信があるからねー！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like this ship won't get smashed to pieces if we just sit here.
Might as well put my money on you lot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうせこのままじゃ船はぶっ壊されちまう。
だったら、
お前たちに賭けてみるか！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch! Now... time to get fired up~sa!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとねー！
じゃあ、
張り切っていくさー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Wow, quite the lively monster!
But we're not about to lose to you in the energy department!
Haitaiii♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
元気いっぱいだね～！
でも、
元気さなら
こっちも負けないよ～！
ハ
イターイ♪

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
Oi, is this any time for pleasantries?
I'm sure you know already, but that monster's invincible in the sea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
挨拶してる場合か！
分かってると思うが、
あの魔物は海の中じゃ無敵だ！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: We'll have to finish it off the instant it comes up onto the surface! You might only get one chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海上に出てきた瞬間に仕留めるしかねぇからな！
チャンスはあまりないと思え！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I know, I know!
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かってるよー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm great at handling the sea, too!
Back in my hometown, we have a word for people who live their lives by the sea...
text_block_list.orig_text:
海が得意なのは、
私だってそうさー！
私の故郷では
海に生きる人をこう呼ぶよー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: "Uminchu", that's what we call them~!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『うみんちゅ』ってね～！

text_block_list.name: カオリ
text_block_list.text:
けど……
もし失敗して海にでも落ちたら、
いくら泳ぎが上手くても、
ひとたまりもないさー
チャンスは一回、
あの魔物と接触する一度きりだねー！
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど……
もし失敗して海にでも落ちたら、
いくら泳ぎが上手くても、
ひとたまりもないさー
チャンスは一回、
あの魔物と接触する一度きりだねー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hey, can I ask you a favor?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
一つ
お願いしてもいいかなー？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'd really like you to encourage me so I don't mess up~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が失敗しないよう、
勇気づけてほしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: With your words by my side... I'm sure I can do it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の言葉があれば、
きっとやれるから。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ Yeah, everything will work out~saaa♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはー♪
うんっ、
なんくるないさーっ♪

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna ram that thing with the ship!
I'll leave it to you to strike it while it's reeling, "Uminchu" girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おうし！
今から船でアイツに突っ込む！
怯んだところを頼むぜ、
うみんちゅのお嬢ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text: まっかせるさー！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAAAAAAA! TAKE THIIIIIIIIIIS!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおぉぉぉぉぉ！　
くらえぇぇぇぇ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it flinched!
Here I go~sa... Ryukyu Dog Knuck—...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしっ、
怯んだねー！
行くさぁ、
琉球犬
ナックル──！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hyaah... The ship's shaking!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃあっ……
船が揺れてっ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I've been grabbed by the monster's arm...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しまった、
魔物の腕に掴まっ……！？

text_block_list.name: カオリ
text_block_list.text:
まずいさー、
海に引きずり込まれる……！
でも、
身動きがとれないさー……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずいさー、
海に引きずり込まれる……！
でも、
身動きがとれないさー……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: {0}?! That's reckless~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！？　
無茶さーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...! My arm's come loose! ...But...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
腕がほどけたっ！
……
でもっ……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
Hey, he fell into the sea!
And that monster... it's trying to dive straight back underwater...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいっ、
兄ちゃんが海に落ちちまったぞ！？
しかもあの魔物め、
そのまま海中に潜ろうとしてやがる……！

text_block_list.name: カオリ
text_block_list.text:
今すぐ倒さないと、
{0}が……！
でもっ、
魔物が船から離れてくさ……！
海に向かって飛ぶ？　
でも
失敗したら二人とも……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
今すぐ倒さないと、
{0}が……！
でもっ、
魔物が船から離れてくさ……！
海に向かって飛ぶ？　
でも
失敗したら二人とも……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ......This power...!?
Don't tell me... while he was falling into the sea...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
……この力は……！？
まさか、
海に落ちながら……！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It feels like... the Tee-da's burning inside my body...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
体の中に
てぃーだが燃えてるみたいさ～……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You believe in me, don't you...?!
Then it'll definitely be okay...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私を信じてくれてるんだねー……！
なら絶対、
大丈夫……！

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: Hey, young lady?! Don't tell me you're going to jump into the ocean?! If you were to fail...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいお嬢ちゃん！？
まさかっ、
海に飛び込む気か！？
失敗したら……
っ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Everything will work out~saaa!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんくるないさぁぁぁぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to unleash it all!
TRUE RYUKYU DOG...
text_block_list.orig_text:
全てを叩きこむよー！
真
・琉球犬──！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
KNUCKLE RUSH...!
~SAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナックルラッシュ──
さぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ It's my victory~sa!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪
私の勝ちさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The ocean feels amazing after really working up a sweat~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
思いっきり体を動かしたあとの海は
最高だね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah?! Come to think of it, {0}, you can't swim, can you? I'll save you right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ～っ！？
そういえば{0}、
泳げないんだったねー！
今助けるよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...You really gave it your all, even though you can't swim~sa.
You looked so cool~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
泳げないのに、
よく頑張ってくれたさー
格好良かったよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
When I felt your power, it was so warm...
A strength unlike anything I'd ever known welled up inside me~
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の力を感じた時、
すごく温かくて、
今までにない力が
湧き上がってきたんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Umm... You did it all for my sake, didn't you?
Ehehe, I'm so happy I can hardly stand it~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと……
私のため、
なんだよねー……
えへへ、
うれしくて
たまらないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: {0}... you really are my Tee-da♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は、
私のてぃーだだね～……♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
We'll be leaving tomorrow morning.
The ship's safe, but the captain wants to check it just in case~
text_block_list.orig_text:
出発は明日の朝になったよ～
船は
無事だったけど、
念のため
点検したいんだって～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Mm... Thank you so much~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
本当に
ありがとうさー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Well... regarding this latest incident...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～と、
今回のことも
そうなんだけど～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I came to Landosol and found I couldn't go back home...
I've been telling myself "everything will work out~sa", and I've managed to live a cheerful, happy life in my own way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
このランドソルに来て、
故郷に帰れなくなって……
なんくるないさ～
って言いながら、
今まで私なりに元気に、
楽しく過ごしてはきたんだけど～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Doing all sorts of things with you just like this...
It's when I feel the most excited and happy~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして
{0}と一緒に
いろいろしてるときが、
一番ワクワクして、
ウキウキしてるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm really glad I met you, {0}~
So... thank you~
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に
{0}に
会えてよかったよ～
だから、
ありがとう～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Aha~... It's kind of embarrassing to talk so formally, isn't it?
When it comes to me~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～……
改まって喋るのって、
なんか
恥ずかしいね～？
やっぱり私は──

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Well... this is what's best, isn't it~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──これが、
一番だよね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Conveying my feelings with just words...
That's not really like me~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言葉だけで気持ちを伝えるなんて、
私らしくないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I have to sing, dance, be full of energy, have fun, and let my feelings show that way~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
歌って、
踊って、
元気に、
楽しく、
気持ちを伝えないとね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ Let's dance as much as we can today~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪
今日はめいっぱい踊ろう～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The Tee-da might be hiding away for the night, but as long as we're holding hands like this, we can see each other clearly~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
てぃーだは夜に隠れちゃってるけど、
こうして手を繋いでいれば、
お互いのこと、
はっきり見えるからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! E-Ehehe... You can be so unfair, {0}...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
え、
えへへ……
{0}はずるいね～……♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... there's no doubt about it.
Being with {0}...
That's when I'm the most excited, the happiest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり……
間違いないよ～
{0}と一緒にいる時が、
一番ワクワクして、
ウキウキして……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ehe... My heart... it's beating so fast~sa♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
──
でーじ、
ドキドキするさー♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next morning...
text_block_list.orig_text: そして、翌朝。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Mm... The land is drifting further and further away~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………
陸が、
遠くなっていくさー……

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
That young man... he's still waving this way.
Between that and the fight on the deck...
He's a damn fine man.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの兄ちゃん、
まだ手を振ってるな。
甲板での戦いのときといい、
いい男じゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I know right? He's my Tee-da for a reason.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でしょー？
彼は、
私のてぃーだだからねー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: He always goes along with me, even when I'm being pushy, and he always puts his all into singing and dancing with me~
text_block_list.orig_text:
強引な私にいつも付き合ってくれて、
歌とか踊りとか、
一生懸命なわけよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
When I get back home, I'll be able to brag to everyone~sa
About the fun friends I've made, and about him, too.
I've got so many memories, more than I could ever fully tell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷に帰ったら、
みんなに自慢できるさー
楽しい仲間ができたこととか、
彼のこととか。
思い出がいっぱい、
語り尽くせないくらいあるからね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I wish I could have made some more, though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
できれば、
もっとあってもよかったけどね～……

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... well, would you look at that.
The ship's not going anywhere.
Hey, everyone! We're going to stop the ship here for a bit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～……
なんだ。
船が進まなくなってきたな。
おいお前ら！　
この辺で少し、
船を止めるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...? But there's wind, why are you stopping...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
風もあるし、
どうして止めるの～……？

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text:
A ship won't move if you've still got something you're leaving behind on land.
That's just how ships are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
陸地に思い残しがあったら進まねぇんだよ。
──船ってのは。

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: There's a life ring lying around right over there, you know...
text_block_list.orig_text:
浮き輪なら
その辺にあるからよ──

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Such a thing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そんなの……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I don't need it~sa!
After all, I'm an "Uminchu"!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらないさー！
『うみんちゅ』だからね～っ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Captain! Thanks a million! If you ever make it to my hometown, be sure to say hello for me~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
船長さ～ん！　
でーじありがとうね～！
もし私の故郷に着いたら、
よろしくね～♪

text_block_list.name: Ship Captain
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Look at that satisfied expression.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へっ。
すっきりした顔しやがって。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Hey!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ぃっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: HEEEYYY!
text_block_list.orig_text: おーーーぃっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: WAIT FOR MEEEEE~sa!!!

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
*pant pant*... I've finally made it~♪
It was further to land than I thought~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
ふぅ～……
やっと着いた～♪
陸まで思ったより遠かったさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Wondering why I returned?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして、
って顔だね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~ I just stopped overthinking things and let myself be true to my feelings~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～
何にも考えずに、
自分の気持ちに素直になったんだよー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: If I go back home now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
故郷に帰っちゃったら～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'd spend every day dreaming about you, and I'd probably have this funny, fluttery feeling in my chest all the time~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は{0}のことを夢見て、
毎日
胸の辺りが
ムズムズしちゃいそうだから～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~... Do you understand what I'm saying~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
私の言ってる意味、
分かる～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's fine if you don't~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かんなくてもいいよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for dragging you into all this and making you run around after me so much~
However, this is my answer~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっぱい振り回しちゃって、
ごめんね～
でも、
これが私の答えだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'm home~sa♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ただいまさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Beaming with a smile as radiant as the Tee-da she treasured, Kaori threw her arms around {0}, overcome with joy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
太陽のような笑顔で笑うカオリは、
喜びのままに、{0}に抱きついてくるのであった。
